Subject: Quick reference call for personalization POC

Hi Naomi,

We're ramping a personalization POC aimed at product recommendations and storefront personalization. We're in late-stage talks with procurement and need a short 30-minute reference call with a customer who has used Redwood for similar low-latency, multi-region personalization workflows.

Key asks:
- Someone in retail (ideally EU or US) who did a production rollout
- Can speak to latency improvements, cost per 1M tokens, and the rollout timeline
- Available this week or early next week for a brief call

Can you point me to one or two customers we can speak with? If helpful, I can share our risk checklist in advance.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
VP Engineering, ShopWave
ellen.park@shopwave.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Marissa/Ben — ShopWave (VP Eng, Ellen Park) is asking for 30 minutes this week or early next for a retail personalization reference. Requirements: retail customer, production personalization rollout, can talk latency and costs. Any EU or US customers who fit? Please share preferred contact and a short one-line why they're a match.

If it helps, I'll prep a short reference brief and send the customer's contact details and a couple of proposed times.

Thanks Naomi — tagging in Marcus for EU-specific contacts. Quick shortlist based on use case:

1) Grove Retail (Denmark) — Lina Sørensen (Head of ML). Deployed Redwood for catalog personalization + server-side recommendations. Notes: 6–8 week rollout, prioritized latency SLAs, strong cost-reduction from caching.
   Contact: Lina Sørensen <lina@groveretail.com>

2) Tailwind Commerce (US) — Jamal Price (Director of Engineering). Heavy traffic holiday retailer; used our Dedicated offering and saw improved 95th percentile latency.
   Contact: Jamal Price <jamal@tailwindcommerce.com>

3) Novo Personalize (US) — Ryan Chen (CTO). More of a platform play but did a multi-tenant proof that focused on token-cost optimizations.
   Contact: Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@novopersonalize.com>

I've attached the latest advocate roster with availability windows and short bios. If ShopWave prefers EU first, Lina is the best fit; if US, Jamal is the quickest to schedule.

Attachments: [advocate_roster_Q3.pdf (PDF)]

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Advocacy, Redwood Inference

Hi Ellen / Alicia — thanks again. Based on Marissa's shortlist, two quick options that match your asks:

Option A (EU retail): Lina Sørensen — Grove Retail (Denmark) — can speak to production rollout, latency SLAs, and integration with regional caching.
Option B (US retail, high-throughput): Jamal Price — Tailwind Commerce (NY) — can speak to Dedicated deployment, 95th percentile latency improvements, and holiday scaling.

Proposed next steps:
- Tell me which option you prefer (A or B) or if you'd like both.
- Pick a 30-minute slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min (I put a few windows that match the advocates' availability).

I included a short reference brief (attached) that you can share internally. If this is for procurement, I can also include a one-page KPI summary for latency and cost targets.

Thanks — I'll handle intros once you confirm a time.

Best,
Naomi
